claims.notes: Grok Build sends hookEventName with grok's snake_case value (pre_tool_use) beside a hook_event_name key carrying the PascalCase name (github.com/xai-org/grok-build user-guide/10-hooks.md, read 2026-10-11 against v1.0.50), so hook_event_name is read first, but only when event_keys_agree(raw) finds hookEventName naming the same event (its snake_case twin, or the same text); a payload whose two keys disagree is not grok's (Kimi Code sends both, with a camelCase hookEventName). The older camelCase-only shape falls back to hookEventName, which is required either way. Grok Build writes that twin pair for every event (xai-org/grok-build@2bdd1d6 crates/codegen/xai-grok-hooks/src/event.rs, to_hook_json), so an event name grok has no mapping for is still claimed when the pair is twins (event_keys_are_twins) and parses as unknown; the camelCase-only shape carries no such proof.

loads_claude_plugins.how: scans ~/.claude/plugins/*/ (user, auto-trusted) and .claude/plugins/*/ (project, needs trust), plus installed_plugins.json; grok plugin install <dir> --trust; manifest fallback .claude-plugin/plugin.json; off until enabled
loads_claude_plugins.notes: hooks run when enabled and trusted; HSO deny and exit 2 block, other failures fail open
loads_claude_plugins.payload: grok's camelCase envelope with additive Claude snake_case aliases; camelCase authoritative; grok tool names (run_terminal_command)
loads_claude_plugins.witnessed: guard and gate refusal: Grok Build 1.0.62 on Windows 11, 2026-10-17; guard and gate refused with the plugin installed by Claude Code, gate refused with it installed by grok plugin install <dir> --trust (org-plan witness/results/witness-grok-claude-plugin-2026-10-17.md at 25b9d9d)
